items.headline: Coastal Flood Statement issued September 30 at 8:00AM EDT until October 1 at 5:00PM EDT by NWS Miami FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Isolated minor coastal flooding expected.

* WHERE...Coastal Palm Beach County, Coastal Broward County and
Coastal Miami Dade County.

* WHEN...Through Thursday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Some water on low lying roads and property.
items.instruction: Do not drive through flooded roadways.
